name: Product Impact In

behavior.description: A compact product grows into place with a short upward overshoot and one damped landing. Hold the authored pose after the landing.
behavior.targetSelection: Animate every product hook in the selected component together; no stagger is required.
behavior.keyframeTiming: at is seconds from this motion's start; easing on each keyframe applies to the interval ending at the next keyframe.

adaptation: x/y are design-pixel offsets in a 1080x1920 frame, scaled with the frame. Rotation is an additive degree offset and scale multiplies the authored base scale; never replace variant rotation or product-scale. Opacity is absolute. Compose transforms on a motion layer without changing layout, shadows, backdrop, or decorative clip-path. Initialize from the first keyframe at the assigned start, not at page load; sample deterministically from local time and retain the final pose.
